findings.claim: The promote step now reads "Promote the resulting memory" where the base read "resulting observation". S6 (c) names only the source: memorycard form for the promote MCP tool and the CLI. S6 says "nothing else reworded" and T7 says "nothing else". The observation-to-memory change is therefore outside S6. It also makes the line disagree with the unchanged "save an observation" and "one observation id per call" at lines 49-51, which use the old term.

Acceptance item 1 changes "resulting observation" to "resulting memory". S6 (d) allows only the mem_get_observation to mem_get swap on this line, and (f) allows only the query replacement on the following line. The extra wording change was not asked for, and the two sibling occurrences are now inconsistent.

The MCP promote tool takes the memorycard id in a field named engram_id (server.go:171). The new text says N is the memorycard id only for the CLI form, so an agent calling the MCP tool is not told which argument carries the id. S6 (c) does not ask for this, so it is an optional clarification or a follow-up, not a defect against the spec.
